info.name: Trellix EDR Action History Queries API

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of items to return per page

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of items to skip for pagination

items.docs: Retrieve a list of saved queries available in ePO SaaS. Queries can be executed against the data store for reporting and analysis of managed endpoints and security events.

params.name: queryId
params.description: Unique identifier of the saved query

items.docs: Execute a saved query and return its results. Queries run against the ePO SaaS data store and can return device, event, or policy compliance information.
